title: CreateModelRegistryRequest
description: Request object for creating model registry.

namespace.description: The namespace of the model registry.

s3AccessKey.description: The S3 access key of Ozone.

s3SecretKey.description: The S3 secret key of Ozone.

environmentCrn.description: The environment CRN of model registry.

environmentName.description: The environment for the model registry to create.

usePublicLoadBalancer.description: The boolean flag to request a public load balancer. By default, a private load balancer is used.

subnetsForLoadBalancers.description: The list of subnets used for the load balancer that Cloudera AI creates.

outboundTypes.description: Outbound Types provided for the cluster.

privateCluster.description: Whether to create a private cluster.

provisionK8sRequest.description: The request for Kubernetes cluster provision. Required in public cloud.

backupCrn.description: The CRN of the backup that this model registry is created from.

whitelistAuthorizedIPRanges.description: Whether to whitelist only authorizedIPRanges given or all public IPs.

authorizedIPRanges.description: The whitelist of CIDR blocks which can access the API server.

disableObjectStoreCsiDriver.description: If true, opt out of enabling the object store CSI driver integration. CSI driver integration offers increased scalability but requires the "Storage Account Contributor" role on Azure.

secondaryPodRangeName.description: The secondary pod range name for GCP.

ModelRegistryProvisionK8sRequest.description: Request object for provisioning model registry.

tags.description: Tags to add to the cloud provider resources created. This is in addition to any tags added by Cloudera.

network.description: The overlay network for an AWS Kubernetes cluster's CNI.

OverlayNetwork.description: Contains the information about overlay network.

plugin.description: The plugin specifies specific cni vendor, ex: calico, weave etc.

gcp.description: The networking options for GCP platform.

ProvisionTag.description: Contains a single tag entry that will be configured on cloud resources associated with a workbench.
